item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find credible 2024 evidence that Jokowi built or strengthened a broad civilian-oversight architecture capable of independently investigating abuse by politically protected actors. I also did not find evidence of a complaint-handling mechanism that was visibly effective in Papua or elsewhere in 2024.
